nsdr.title: NSDR
nsdr.subtitle: Non-sleep deep rest · 10–30 min
nsdr.done: Done. Take a moment before you get up.
steps: Lie down and close your eyes.
Move your attention through your body, one spot at a time.
Just feel. No need to stop your thoughts.

focus.title: Focus session
focus.subtitle: Get ready, then work · micro-rests
focus.intro: Before deep work, set yourself up. Tick what you've done.
prep: No heavy, starchy meal before work (or work fasted)
prepNoFast: No heavy, starchy meal before work
focus.beatsBody: Use headphones. About 5 min before or during work.
focus.restHint: Now and then, take a 10 s pause with no input. Your brain replays what you just did.

errors85.title: 85% rule
errors85.subtitle: Find the right difficulty while learning
errors85.intro: Tally each real attempt. The sweet spot is about 15% mistakes, up to 30% for movement skills.

zone.start: Keep going. A few more tries first.
zone.easy: Too easy. Make it a bit harder.
zone.hard: Too hard. Aim for about {p}% mistakes.

selfTest.title: Self-test
selfTest.subtitle: Recall without notes · 1–5 min
selfTest.done: Done. That effort is what makes it stick.
steps: Close your eyes. No notes, no book.
Recall everything you just learned, or run through the moves.
Stuck? Note it and check after.

nutrition.title: My nutrition
nutrition.subtitle: Your protein and water numbers
nutrition.proteinBody: 1.6–2.2 g per kg of body weight. Aim for 30–50 g at each full meal.
nutrition.waterNote: Hot day or heavy sweat: add 50–100%. Later in the day, sip slowly.
nutrition.cpcBody: Grams of complete protein per 150 kcal.

jetlag.title: Jet-lag plan
jetlag.subtitle: Light and sleep timing for trips
jetlag.stayHome: Short trip: stay on home time. Eat, sleep and get light as you would at home.
jetlag.noShift: No time change, no jet lag to fix.
jetlag.tmin: Your body's low point is about 2 h before your usual wake ({wake}). At the destination that's {time} local time.
jetlag.eastBefore: Wake 30–45 min earlier. Get bright light right away, have caffeine, and exercise within an hour.
jetlag.westBefore: Wake, have caffeine and exercise 30–45 min later. See bright light for 1–2 h after sunset.
jetlag.eastLight: Sun or a bright light, local time. This pulls your clock forward.
jetlag.eastDark: Avoid bright light now so your clock doesn't slip back.
jetlag.westLight: Bright light, local time. This keeps you up later.
both: Eat on local time from day one. You can fast 14–16 h before the first local breakfast.

supps.title: Supplement guides
supps.subtitle: Reference only, with safety notes
supps.warn: Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor first, especially if you take medication. Try one at a time. Pick tested products (NSF or USP).
supps.warnRisk: You told us about a health risk (pregnancy, heart or illness). Don't take any of these without your doctor.
supps.footer: Life OS never adds supplements to your Sprint. Habits come first.
